run_eval_webshop_episodes: run the webshop evaluation script to test model inference on val or test split episodes
run_eval_with_max_steps: run the webshop eval with a custom max_steps limit and output directory for results
run_eval_break_cycles: run the webshop eval with cycle breaking enabled to filter repeated state-action predictions
run_eval_output_html: run the webshop eval and write prediction screenshots to HTML files for visualization
write_json_metrics: write evaluation metrics dictionary to a JSON file using tf.io.gfile
